notes.title: 1.3.0: Level redesign
notes.content:
Hello everybody! We've just posted a bigger update where we reworked most of the levels' tilesets so that there is a little more visual diversity in the game.

We'd also like to let you know that we are currently working on a series of major updates where we'll add a bunch of new characters along with more abilities (including character-unique ones), more levels with different game mechanics in them, and of course more enemies! Stay tuned.

notes.title: Leaderboards
notes.content:
Hi there!
Leaderboards are now fully functional. Adding a little bit of competiotional flavour to the game.

notes.title: We are live now!
notes.content:
This is a great step for us: our first game is officially live now!
Please provide any feedback via Steam community tools and let's see how far can we get together.
